forecast.selection_metric: Lowest mean rolling-origin WAPE (MAE tie-break; final test unseen)
limitations: Rolling-origin results estimate stability across historical synthetic periods; no causal or operational performance claim.
Synthetic growth-weighted dates and embedded promotions limit real-world forecasting value.
Recursive fixed-origin predictions use no observed fold/test target values.
Fiscal year and calendar year are treated as identical in this demonstration.
Associations were embedded by the synthetic generator; these are demonstration results.
Transaction IDs are valid baskets; anonymous transactions remain included.
Synthetic customer IDs only; anonymous sales excluded.
Unsupervised descriptive clusters; no classification accuracy or customer targeting claim.
Precision, recall and F1 apply only to deterministic injected high-quantity anomalies, not real-world fraud or every business anomaly.
Unlabeled unusual records are counted as negatives, so measured precision can understate useful review flags.
Large legitimate orders can be flagged; human review is required.
Only 30 generated SKUs and five stores have daily inventory snapshots.
ABC/XYZ classifications describe generated demand and are not replenishment policy recommendations.
Before/during comparison is descriptive and does not establish causal promotion lift.
Promotions are generated and applied broadly in the canonical demonstration.
Shipment records are generated educational telemetry.
